items.title: ggml/llama.cpp releases: b10795
items.description:
<details open>

sycl: fuse rms_norm+mul+add and add+add residual chains (#27610)

Fuse RMS_NORM+MUL+ADD and ADD+ADD under GGML_SYCL_ENABLE_FUSION.

ADD+ADD uses the same binbcast indexing and type matrix as standalone
add() (f32, f16, f16/f32, i32, i16, bf16, including broadcast and
non-contiguous).
items.summary: The ggml/llama.cpp project updated its codebase to fuse RMS_NORM+MUL+ADD and ADD+ADD operations under SYCL fusion, enhancing computational efficiency.
